'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Cuba blackout]]
**A nationwide [[power outage]] occurs in [[Cuba]] following a critical failure at the Antonio Guiteras [[power station]] in [[Puerto Padre]], [[Las Tunas Province]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/10/18/americas/cuba-blackout-power-plant-failure-intl-latam/index.html (CNN)]
*Six people are killed and 25 injured after a bus overturned in [[Aksaray]], [[Turkey]]. [https://www.ekathimerini.com/news/1251297/six-dead-25-injured-in-turkey-bus-accident/ (Ekathimerini)]
*A bus carrying Japanese tourists crashed into a ditch in [[Afyonkarahisar province]] [[Turkey]], injuring 22.[https://apnews.com/article/turkey-japanese-tourists-bus-accident-441ea260b0328d635762e2f06d5956db (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Foreign involvement in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]], [[North Korea–Ukraine relations]]
***The [[South Korea]]n [[National Intelligence Service (South Korea)|National Intelligence Service]] says that [[North Korea]] has started sending troops to fight with [[Russia]] in [[Ukraine]]. [[South Korean President]] [[Yoon Suk Yeol]] calls for a security meeting and says the international community must respond with "all available means". [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c3vkqwe9wwdo (BBC)]
*[[Swiss neutrality]]
**[[Switzerland]] joins the [[European Sky Shield Initiative]] to contribute to building a pan-European air and [[Missile defense|missile defense system]], while also allowing the nation to train and purchase military systems with other [[European nations]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/neutral-switzerland-signs-declaration-join-european-sky-shield-initiative-2024-10-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[Western Sahara conflict]]
**[[Morocco]] rejects a proposal put forward by the [[UN]] envoy for [[Western Sahara]] [[Staffan de Mistura]] that would partition Western Sahara with the northern part being annexed by Morocco and the southern part forming an [[Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic|independent state]] controlled by the [[Polisario Front]]. [https://www.atalayar.com/en/articulo/politics/morocco-rejects-misturas-proposal-for-partition-of-western-sahara/20241018113213206388.html (Atalayar)]
